name: Update all dependencies including major versions
description:
# Update all dependencies including major versions

## Context

Monorepo (clients/start, clients/web, packages/*, servers/api) has 66 outdated
dependencies. The user wants a full update including all major version bumps.

Constraints discovered:
- pnpm-workspace.yaml sets minimumReleaseAge: 10080 (7 days), so published-within-7-days
  versions are NOT installable. pnpm outdated already reflects this filtered view.
  e.g. vite 8.3.2 (pub 2026-10-01) blocked, 8.3.1 is the real target.
  vitest 5.0.3 (pub 2026-09-30) and fallow 3.31.0 (pub 2026-09-30) also blocked.
- packageManager is pnpm@11.2.2, nodeVersion 24.16.0 with engineStrict: true.
- Existing version skew: clients/start is on vite 8 / @vitejs/plugin-react 6 /
  typescript 6, while clients/web and packages/storybook-base are on vite 7 /
  plugin-react 5. Bumping web+storybook to vite 8 REDUCES drift.
- Catalog in pnpm-workspace.yaml pins @typescript/native-preview to
  7.0.0-dev.20260514.1 (target 7.0.0-dev.20260707.2).
- pnpm ai is the mandated gate, but `fallow dupes` has PRE-EXISTING failures in
  clients/web (app.tsx, auth-page-aside.tsx, use-auth-page-controller.ts, ~90 lines
  of clone groups). User chose to leave those. So pnpm ai will remain non-zero at
  the fallow dupes step ONLY; every other step must pass.

## Baseline established

- WIP committed as e2f7573 (feat: add tanstack start client).
- lint:types (tsgo --noEmit) is CLEAN.
- Pre-existing red: fallow dupes (3 web files), fmt (5 web + 3 shared + 1 api files).
- New red from clients/start: 16 i18n hardcoded strings, 2 no-floating-promises,
  fallow dead-code unused type exports + unused tailwind-merge dep, 27 unformatted files.

## Execution order

1. In-range updates first (lockfile-only, no manifest edits) so later work builds
   on the newest in-range versions and avoids rework.
2. Fix clients/start to repo standards so pnpm ai becomes a usable gate.
3. Major upgrades one group at a time, verifying after each.

## Acceptance criteria

- All 66 outdated deps resolved to their age-gate-allowed latest.
- Every `pnpm ai` step passes except the known pre-existing `fallow dupes`.
- All package builds and test suites pass.
